headline: Revenue steady, EPS drop distorted by a prior-year gain
summary_short: IFF reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.954B (+1.8% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.20, down 91.4% y/y from $2.33; net income fell to $50M from $599M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $1.954B, up 1.8% y/y from $1.919B. Gross profit rose 3.5% y/y to $853M; operating income rose 11.3% y/y to $158M. Diluted EPS fell 91.4% y/y to $0.20 from $2.33, and net income fell 91.7% y/y to $50M from $599M. Total cash was $569M, down 30.3% y/y from $816M; long-term debt fell 16.7% y/y to $4.735B from $5.684B.
